name: Ticket Source Import and Reconciliation
foundation_dependencies: LLD-02 SettingDefinitionRegistry/SettingStore and exact Customer/Contact matching interfaces
LLD-03 exact Service Request/RFC source-evidence readers and mutation services including SR Customer/Contact/reference ownership
LLD-05 exact WFM/Task source-projection and operational-plan mutation interfaces
LLD-06 same-UoW SLA/classification consequence participant for accepted SR Customer/classification-affecting changes
scope: shared ticket workbook import framework across Advanced Search SR, Enhanced RFC and Service Provider WFM
separate Advanced Search inbox setting plus shared RFC/WFM directory semantics
smallest-safe-scope reconciliation proposals/dispositions and explicit older/equal-chronology recovery
Advanced Search SR identity/source-field/disappearance/Customer/Contact/reference proposals into exact LLD-02/03 owner interfaces
review/no-change classification and deterministic review projections
not_owned_here: SR/RFC authoritative identity/current lifecycle/current source projection and SR Customer/Contact relationship history -> LLD-03
Customer/Contact master identity, affiliation and setting persistence -> LLD-02
WFM/Task identity/current source projection/operational plan/Objective consequences -> LLD-05
operator-facing file artifact generation/export/publication -> not owned by LLD-04; XLSX workbooks are untrusted source inputs only and are never generated by this packet
transaction_boundaries: Workbook discovery, stabilization, security validation, parsing, normalization, fingerprinting and proposal calculation occur outside authoritative domain mutation transactions.
Unpublished validating-run staging may use bounded technical transactions but has no source/review/domain authority until complete atomic publication.

Every accepted reconciliation proposal uses exactly one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork and one command receipt; owning-domain services and required participants use that same UnitOfWork and never commit independently.
Run finalization and eligible source-checkpoint update are atomic; recovery authorization/disposition is append-only and never itself fabricates SR/RFC/WFM/Task authority.
failure_modes: unsafe, unstable, inaccessible, malformed or unsupported selected workbook fails visibly without silent fallback to an older candidate
Advanced Search manual selection lacking supported population chronology may be safely previewed but cannot publish/checkpoint/mutate authority
partial/interrupted staging remains unpublished and cannot establish source presence/replay/proposals/checkpoint
identity/header/content ambiguity blocks only the smallest safe scope unless workbook-level integrity makes isolation unsafe
proposal acceptance fails closed on stale proposal/base/reference-generation/lifecycle/plan/recovery state
Customer/Contact ambiguity remains unresolved and never blocks independently valid SR source facts
nested commit, partial owner mutation or checkpoint disagreement rolls back through the shared UnitOfWork
review_evidence: Prior RFC/WFM semantics were preserved while the shared framework was extended to Advanced Search SR rather than creating a parallel importer.
advanced_search_sr is wired through source-family schema, discovery, routes, commands, observations, proposals, settings, UI and traceability.
Population disappearance is represented by population_absence bound to the current complete run plus prior_source_observation_id; no fabricated current observation exists.

LLD-03 owns canonical history-preserving SR Customer/customer_contact/current_handler_reference relationships and stores exact LLD-04 source_observation_field_id evidence; LLD-02 owns Contact/Customer identity.
Eight authoritative mutation/transition contracts are split into dedicated V2 command leaves; queries/types/routes/audit/job/migration/module/settings/transition/traceability registries are explicit.
Pre-promotion LLD Spec Integrity run 34072741523 at commit 1c1379f7c4db1c5e898284eddad12cd7542e25e6 reported no LLD-04 BLOCKER/HIGH findings.
design_principle: Every workbook is untrusted immutable source evidence first. Shared discovery/security/fingerprint/recovery mechanics are reused across all three source families; accepted operational changes cross only exact owning-domain interfaces after replay, chronology, stale-state and review checks. Source labels and Current Handler text remain evidence rather than relational identity.
